intent: The Compositions left-rail panel — a scrollable, data-driven list of slide thumbnails that drives slide selection, rename, and the new-slide action.
guidance: Presentational and fully controlled: pass a `slides` array plus callbacks (onNewSlide, onRenameRequest, onTitleChange, onTitleMenu, onSlideDuplicate, onSlideDelete) — the host owns selection, order, and persistence. One `SlideData` drives each row's state, so branch on the data, not on section-local code. Theme-aware via `c-*` tokens (dark under `data-composa-mode`). Slide actions live on right-click only — there is no hover ⋯ — and the menu appears only when a rename/duplicate/delete callback is wired. The New slide button is deliberately one plain action, not a split/template control. Thumbnails honor the project `aspectRatio` while the reserved slot height stays constant across ratios; sub-slides carry a deeper inset.

anatomy.description: Fixed 40px row holding the inline-rename project title — a button that swaps to a bordered input on click/Enter — plus a trailing chevron button that opens the project options menu.
Full-width bordered button (Plus icon + "New slide"), fenced by top and bottom dividers. The panel's only primary action; not segmented, no template chevron.
Scrollable listbox (overlay scrollbar) of slide rows, ordered top-to-bottom; roving focus across rows.

Number badge (top-left) beside a project-ratio thumbnail centered in a fixed slot. Group rows add an expand chevron; motion rows add a badge on the thumbnail; stacked rows add peek cards behind it; sub-slides indent deeper.
Cursor-anchored context menu opened on right-click — Rename, Duplicate, a divider, then a destructive Delete; a backdrop closes it.

use_when: Listing a project's slides/compositions in the left rail with live thumbnails and single-select navigation.
You want a data-driven list where one SlideData drives each row's state (group, sub-slide, stacked, motion, selected, in-view).
Rename and the New slide insert are the primary actions you need to surface.
dont_use_when: You need to store slide order or persistence, or wire drag-to-reorder — the editor owns the data model; this is presentational only.
Editing the selected element's properties — use Inspector.
You need multi-select or the full copy/paste context menu — the source renders neither yet.

radius.note: New slide button rounded-[6px], thumbnail rounded-[5px], motion badge rounded-[2px], stacked peek cards rounded-[4px]/[3px] are hardcoded px radii, not radius tokens.

type.body-medium: var(--composa-body-medium-size|line|weight|letter-spacing) on the slide number and the New slide label
type.note: The header title is hardcoded text-[13px] font-[550] leading-[22px] tracking-[-0.0325px]; font family is inline Inter, sans-serif — not type tokens.

tokens.note: Thumbnail fill is bg-white with a #111 fallback tint; stacked peek cards use bg-white and a #fff gradient with rgba shadows. Because #hex literals exist, tokensOnly is not asserted.

a11y.role: listbox — the slide list is role="listbox" (aria-label "Compositions"); each row is role="option" with aria-selected and aria-label "Composition {n}". The 200px panel container itself carries no landmark role.
a11y.keyboard: Roving tabIndex across rows; Arrow/Home/End move focus, Enter requests rename, Space activates the row.
a11y.labels: New slide, Project options, Rename project {title}, and the rename input ("Project name") each carry aria-label.
a11y.focus: focus-visible ring on rows via ring-c-border-selected.

code.example:
<SlidesPanel
  title="Product review"
  slides={[
    { n: 1, thumb: cover, selected: true },
    { n: 2, group: true, expanded: true },
    { n: 3, sub: true, motion: true },
  ]}
  aspectRatio={16 / 9}
  onNewSlide={addSlide}
  onRenameRequest={(i) => renameSlide(i)}
  onSlideDuplicate={(i) => duplicateSlide(i)}
  onSlideDelete={(i) => deleteSlide(i)}
/>
